description: This file defines and manages TypeMeta data structures and functions for handling type information in the caffe2 namespace, including error handling, type metadata array initialization, and known type registration.

classes.name: TypeMeta
classes.description: Class managing type metadata information, including error handling and metadata array management.

methods.name: _ThrowRuntimeTypeLogicError
methods.description: Function to throw runtime type logic errors with a message.

methods.name: error_unsupported_typemeta
methods.description: Function to handle unsupported TypeMeta errors, marked as noreturn.

methods.name: getTypeMetaDatasLock
methods.description: Returns a mutex lock for thread-safe access to TypeMeta data.

methods.name: typeMetaDatas
methods.description: Returns a fixed array of TypeMetaData instances representing type information.

methods.name: existingMetaDataIndexForType
methods.description: Finds the index of existing TypeMetaData for a given TypeIdentifier.
